segments.sn35.163:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko…pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.163:1.3: “Yaṃ kho, koṭṭhika, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.5: Cakkhu kho, koṭṭhika, dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.6: Rūpā dukkhā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.7: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.8: Cakkhusamphasso dukkho; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.9: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn35.163:1.10: jivhā dukkhā; tatra te chando pahātabbo…pe…
segments.sn35.163:1.11: mano dukkho; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.12: Dhammā dukkhā; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.13: Manoviññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.14: Manosamphasso dukkho; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.15: Yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ; tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.163:1.16: Yaṃ kho, koṭṭhika, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.

lines: Sattamādīsu tīsu therassa vimuttiparipācaniyā dhammāva kathitā. 10-12.
Therassa tadā saddhādīni indriyāni na paripākaṃ upagatāni, thero imāhi desanāhi indriyaparipākamagamāsi.
